summary: The source permits at most ten asynchronous functions, while correctness depends on invoking all functions without serial waits, preserving result indices, rejecting on the first failure, and eventually settling rather than on scalable wall-clock growth.

workload_bound.source_constraint: functions.length is between one and ten

replacement_checks.evidence: The implementation performs one immediate invocation and installs one fulfillment/rejection chain for each of the n functions, then writes each successful value once.
Authored schedules cover one and ten functions, immediate fulfillment, out-of-order completion, late rejection, competing rejection times, and tied rejection times.

The deterministic app adapter records every start time, settlement time, ordered values, and rejection reason so cases verify parallel start, input order, last-success completion, and first-failure settlement.
The exact native promise source is remotely Accepted under the provider timeout, and every deterministic local schedule reaches a finite settlement.
